other_conditions: All new micro manufacturing enterprises established anywhere in Tamil Nadu are eligible
All new small and medium manufacturing enterprises established in the 251 industrially backward blocks are eligible
All new agro‑based industries in the 385 blocks of the state are eligible

Existing manufacturing enterprises of the above categories can apply if they undertake expansion or diversification that increases plant and machinery value by at least 25 % and turnover by at least 25 % for the same or new product lines
Only enterprises using Low Tension Power supply (Tariff III B) are eligible

For enterprises with multiple LT connections at the same premises, subsidy is available only for the first connection; each branch unit at a different location may receive subsidy for its first connection
Application must be filed within three months from the date of commencement of commercial production or power connection, whichever is later
benefits_summary: A 20 % LTPT subsidy is provided for 36 months to eligible enterprises.
